job.heaterFaultBody: The heater was switched off. Check wiring and sensor before resetting the fault.
job.doorOpenBody: The build chamber is open. Chamber temperature is dropping.
job.filamentMonitorBody: Check filament path, spool and feeder.

prepareBed.title: Prepare bed
prepareBed.s1Body: The machine parks the print heads and lowers the bed. Keep the build chamber clear while the movement runs.
prepareBed.s1Warn: The bed may still be hotter than 60 °C.
prepareBed.s2Body: Release the part from the build plate. With PA6 CF HT let the bed cool below 50 °C, then the part releases by itself.
prepareBed.s2Warn: Do not place tools on the build plate.
prepareBed.s3Body: Remove residue and support material, check the plate for damage and re-insert it. The machine is then ready for the next job.
prepareBed.s3Warn: The plate must snap in completely before the next print starts.

home.title: Home axes
home.s1Body: The build chamber must be clear before homing. Remove parts, tools and filament remains from the bed.
home.s2Body: The machine moves all axes to their end positions. Do not reach into the build chamber while it moves.
home.s2Warn: Do not reach into the build chamber.
home.s3Body: All axes are referenced. The machine is ready for the next step.

calibrate.title: Calibrate
calibrate.zeroDesc: The scanning zero probe captures the zero point in the print plane.
calibrate.meshDesc: Record a height map of the whole bed. Replaces the stored map.
calibrate.alignZDesc: Align the four Z lead screws to each other.

preheat.title: Preheat
preheat.intro: Target temperatures follow the loaded materials. Tools are heated to standby.
preheat.macroHint: The preheat macro sets bed and tools according to the loaded filament profiles.

filament.title: Change filament
filament.s1Title: Which print head do you want to load?
filament.s1Body: Choose the tool whose filament should be changed.
filament.s2Body: The list matches the filament profiles on the machine. Temperatures and parameters come from the profile.
filament.s3Body: The machine heats up, unloads the old filament and feeds the new one automatically. Follow the on-screen prompts.
filament.s3Warn: The nozzle gets hot. Do not reach into the build chamber.
filament.i1: The old filament is unloaded. Remove the spool.
filament.i2: Mount the new spool and push the filament into the feeder up to the stop.
filament.i3: The machine feeds automatically and calibrates the filament monitor.
filament.spoolHint: While loading, the machine asks for spool size, spool body and weight and tracks the remaining amount from then on. New spool of the same material, or a correction: "Record spool".

settings.macrosHint: G-code per action of the operator UI. Multiple lines are allowed; M98 P"" means “not configured”.

support.serialHint: Have the serial number ready, it is shown in the header below the machine name. For remote support export the diagnostics and attach the file.
support.diagnosticsHint: Save object model, firmware diagnostics (M122) and event log as a file.
